description: Storage, drives and hardware of the Synology NAS, from DSM's own status over SNMP and from node-exporter. CPU, memory and filesystems are on Hosts and Node Exporter Full.

panels.title: DSM hardware
panels.description: Worst of DSM's system, power-supply and fan status.

panels.title: Storage pool and volume
panels.description: DSM's RAID status. Repairing, expanding and other operations show in yellow; degraded and crashed in red.

panels.title: Volume used
panels.description: Share of each volume's capacity in use. HostFilesystemLow fires below 10% free.

panels.title: Disks needing attention
panels.description: Disks DSM reports as failed or with any health warning. A disk outside every pool reports "Not initialized" and is not counted.

panels.title: Hottest disk
panels.description: Highest drive temperature. NasDiskHot fires above 50 C for 15 minutes.

panels.title: UPS
panels.description: Power source of the UPS DSM is attached to.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (upsInfoStatus{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node",upsInfoStatus=~"(.* )?LB( .*)?"}) * 3 or max by (instance) (upsInfoStatus{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node",upsInfoStatus=~"(.* )?OB( .*)?"}) * 2 or max by (instance) (upsInfoStatus{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"})

panels.title: Drive bays
panels.description: One row per bay. Status and health are DSM's own assessment. Busy is the share of time the drive had I/O in flight over 5 minutes. The last four columns are raw SMART counters (IDs 5, 197, 198, 199); any non-zero value is worth a look, and CRC errors usually point at the bay or cable rather than the drive.

targets.expr: sum by (diskID) (label_replace((diskSMARTAttrRaw{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"} and on (instance, diskSMARTInfoIndex) (diskSMARTAttrId{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"} == 9)) * on (instance, diskSMARTInfoIndex) group_left (diskSMARTInfoDevName) diskSMARTInfoDevName{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"}, "diskID", "Disk $1", "diskSMARTInfoDevName", "/dev/sata(\\d+)"))

sum by (diskID) (label_replace((diskSMARTAttrRaw{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"} and on (instance, diskSMARTInfoIndex) (diskSMARTAttrId{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"} == 5)) * on (instance, diskSMARTInfoIndex) group_left (diskSMARTInfoDevName) diskSMARTInfoDevName{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"}, "diskID", "Disk $1", "diskSMARTInfoDevName", "/dev/sata(\\d+)"))

sum by (diskID) (label_replace((diskSMARTAttrRaw{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"} and on (instance, diskSMARTInfoIndex) (diskSMARTAttrId{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"} == 198)) * on (instance, diskSMARTInfoIndex) group_left (diskSMARTInfoDevName) diskSMARTInfoDevName{job="synology-snmp",platform="synology",instance=~"$node"}, "diskID", "Disk $1", "diskSMARTInfoDevName", "/dev/sata(\\d+)"))

panels.title: Volume used
panels.description: Share of each volume's capacity in use; dashed lines at 80% and 90%.

panels.title: Disk temperature
panels.description: Per-drive temperature from DSM; dashed line at the NasDiskHot threshold.

panels.title: Disk busy
panels.description: Share of time each drive had I/O in flight.

panels.title: NFS throughput
panels.description: Bytes the NFS server read from and wrote to disk for its clients.

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Traffic on each physical interface that is up.

panels.title: Battery charge
panels.description: UPS battery charge. Yellow and red at the UPS's own warning (20%) and low (10%) levels.

panels.title: Runtime
panels.description: Estimated runtime on battery at the current load. Red below the UPS's own low-runtime level (5 minutes).

panels.title: Load
panels.description: UPS output load as a share of its rating.
